scenario: Saved room: 3 dolls, 10 furniture items, one visible renderer. One baseline and one optimized process run, sampled at 20/40/60 seconds. Normal device rendering budget varies with heat, so comparison forces contentScaleFactor=1 and bloom off in BOTH runs. Release behavior and normal quality budget are unchanged.
changes: Discard unused embedded texture references in baked furniture cache while preserving original tint.
Reuse equal materials within each furniture build.
Cull back faces only for known closed cushion meshes; retain two-sided fabric fibers and open geometry.
limitations: Single paired run; not continuous peak measurement or long-duration soak.
Both runs reported serious thermal state (2); no temperature or power reduction is established.
Instruments Game Performance attachment timed out waiting for the device; no GPU-time result is claimed.
Do not compare these fixed-budget numbers directly with the user's earlier 600 MB observation or infer ordinary full-quality memory from them.
The final optimized build also disables auto-lock only during diagnostic sampling and records timestamps; rendering code is identical to the visual-validation build.
